column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST (cleat#3629, owner D59-b): each of these three tests builds its rig inside a t.Run per dialect, so the arms for the dialects this job does not configure skip while the one it does RUNS. Three tests, one skip per absent arm. Measured 2026-10-30 by running them with only PostgreSQL configured: `go test ./engine/ -run '<the three>' -json | grep '"Action":"skip"'`.

dialect-gated per SUBTEST (cleat#3629): the sharded clash test loops over publishDialects, whose subtests are named postgres and mssql (not sqlserver), and builds three scratch databases of that dialect, so the arm for an unconfigured dialect skips. Measured 2026-10-30 with only PostgreSQL configured.

single-dialect test (cleat#3629): it asserts that the SQL Server reader leaves the connection's SESSION_CONTEXT as it found it, which exists only on SQL Server, so it skips whole in a job with no SQL Server. Measured 2026-10-30 with only PostgreSQL configured.
